newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus imports rise, exports fall in January.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus imports rise, exports fall in January.

text.p: Cyprus's imports rose to 159.3 million pounds ($308.3 million) in January from 151.4 million pounds in January 1996, the statistics department said on Monday.
Exports fell to 48.8 million pounds in January from 51.1 million in January 1996.
The statistics department said European Union countries supplied 44.1 percent of the total imports in January 1997, and absorbed 59 percent of total Cypriot exports. ($=0.516 pounds)
